<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 17"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Fearsome Form](/Feats.aspx?ID=5320) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Auditory" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=541" />
<trait label="Awakened Animal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=787" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 27

</column>

---

A fearsome illusion covers you, evoking the terror of the most dangerous animals. You can cast [_mask of terror_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1595) as a primal innate spell once per day. You can target only yourself, and your appearance is always a monstrous version of yourself.
name: Fearsome Form
